statusArea.rootCause: Fixed cyan theme-color, white manifest launch background, Apple default status style; no early theme-aware system metadata
statusArea.implementation: Light #f4f5f7/default; Dark #111827/black; Slate #07111d/black. Existing content offsets and safe-area CSS retained.
statusArea.limitations: Apple black is opaque black on documented legacy standalone behavior, not arbitrary CRM hex. Dynamic changes and exact modern iOS behavior need real hardware verification. No black-translucent content overlay introduced.

refresh.pull: Mobile touch gesture at top of actual scroll ancestors; 110 raw vertical pixels to arm (66 damped pixels); release required; horizontal, form controls, dialogs, body scroll lock and visible keyboard excluded; cancel resets gesture
refresh.resume: visibilitychange, focus and pageshow; stale after 45000 ms; successful fetch timestamps; no polling; shared in-flight promise
refresh.manual: Localized small item in existing mobile More sheet; unsupported/new screens excluded
scope: Dashboard RSC via router.refresh and UpcomingEvents loader
Tasks scoped tasks and case lookups
refresh.dirtyProtection: Registered ready checks delay refresh. Case tracks local revisions and acknowledged server version to reject stale responses even if an intervening autosave finishes. Manual detail forms retain conservative input revision guards. No hard reload.

autosave.architecture: One serialized state machine; minimal diff patch; manual Save flushes the same queue; edited-during-flight values drain with the next acknowledged version
autosave.status: Compact localized idle/dirty/saving/saved/error/conflict near existing Save; no per-keystroke toast
autosave.concurrency: All Case PATCH writes require loaded updatedAt; scoped PostgreSQL CAS transaction includes standard/custom fields, status history and ordinary-date reminders. 409 retains edits; missing version returns explicit 428, including status-only writes. Current list and standalone custom callers were adapted.
autosave.network: Retains patch and dirty input; error never claims Saved; explicit Retry; 409 requires explicit confirmed reload; no offline storage
autosave.navigation: Authenticated Next/PostgreSQL QA passed app Back, browser Back, other Case via list, bottom navigation and another CRM section. Pending safe edits flush before navigation without ordinary confirms. Failures/drafts retain the existing leave warning. Native iOS process termination remains unverified.
autosave.manualSave: Retained on desktop/mobile, available while autosave is in flight, drains the same queue. Only totalValue/cabinetLogin/cabinetPassword require explicit standard Save. Custom fields and four previously excluded dates now autosave.
autosave.ordinaryFields: Explicit allowlist in src/lib/caseAutosave.ts: text/select/toggle, service/responsible, notes/personal appearance note, ordinary case/contract fields and server-synchronized important dates
autosave.phase3: Not started; Leads/Clients/Tasks autosave remains deferred.
autosave.customFields: Active organization-owned Case custom fields (text, textarea, number, date, email, checkbox, select), stored as custom:<id> in the same queue and as minimal customFieldValues in the same Case CAS transaction. They do not invoke financial or credential APIs.
specialHandling: MOS ID: explicit DocUpdate delete/create API, retained manual because it replaces an existing record
Payments and payment plans: explicit financial/task APIs
Custom date creation/deletion: explicit CaseCustomDate APIs
Comments and document update records: explicit APIs
Document uploads/deletes and MOS document submission: explicit APIs

qaEnvironment.next: real Next 14.2.35 at 127.0.0.1:3107, synthetic tenants/users, real UI login and auth cookies
qaEnvironment.browser: headless installed Microsoft Edge through Playwright
qaEnvironment.scope: Real routes and DB, no fixture API mocks in the authenticated run. Network failures/delays, touch release and focus/time events are simulated in the browser. No real iPhone hardware.
qaEnvironment.cleanup: COMPLETED: QA Next dev/start processes stopped; named disposable PostgreSQL container and its anonymous volume removed. Production untouched.
reproduce: Start a disposable postgres:16 container bound only to 127.0.0.1:55432 with database legalhub_case_qa and synthetic postgres password disposable-case-qa.
Set DATABASE_URL to that exact loopback QA database. Run npx prisma db push --skip-generate. Do not use production environment files.

Load only the existing CREATE FUNCTION/CREATE TRIGGER tail of prisma/migrations/20260922140000_staff_routing_v2/migration.sql into that QA DB, since db push omits SQL triggers needed by the pre-existing routing regression.
Set a synthetic JWT_SECRET and NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; run npx next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3107.
Set LEGALHUB_QA_NODE_MODULES to the bundled node_modules containing Playwright; run node scripts/qa-case-postgres.cjs and node scripts/qa-case-security-postgres.cjs with the loopback DATABASE_URL.
Run node --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/security/*.test.mjs with RUN_DB_TESTS=1 against only that disposable DB.
Stop the QA Next process and remove the named QA container/volume. Build uses DATABASE_URL pointed at loopback port 1, no migration/seed/deploy.
